components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one rose fill on a page: Generate, Save to profile.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 15px 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-fg); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.005em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hi); border-color: var(--accent-hi); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--accent-press); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The default action: a bench-slate fill with a 1px rule, used for Check Salad status and Cancel selected.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface); color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.005em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--wash); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Labelled Field
components.description: A mono label above a dark, recessed input. The label is always there; a placeholder never replaces it.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; } .ds-field label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-muted); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--field); color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); transition: border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--fg-muted); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--fg-muted); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Rail Item
components.description: A numbered page link. The number is the address; the active row is rose wash with a 2px rose edge.
components.html: 01Config02Prompt Settings03Tokens
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; padding: 10px; background: var(--surface); border-radius: var(--radius-card); } .ds-rail-link { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 10px; border-left: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--fg-muted); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.2; transition: background 100ms ease, color 100ms ease; } .ds-rail-link:hover { background: var(--wash); color: var(--fg); } .ds-rail-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-num { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; min-width: 2ch; } .ds-rail-link.ds-on { background: var(--rose-wash); color: var(--fg); border-left-color: var(--accent); } .ds-rail-link.ds-on .ds-rail-num { color: var(--accent); }

components.name: LoRA Card
components.description: A selectable card in a reflowing grid: checkbox, name, family and version tags. The whole card is the click target.
components.css: .ds-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(232px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; } .ds-lora { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: 'box name' '. tags'; column-gap: 8px; row-gap: 3px; align-content: start; min-height: 62px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: var(--radius-card); background: var(--well); line-height: 1.3; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-lora:hover { border-color: var(--rule); background: var(--wash); } .ds-lora.ds-on { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent); background: var(--rose-wash); } .ds-lora input { grid-area: box; width: 15px; height: 15px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; } .ds-lora-name { grid-area: name; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--fg); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-lora-meta { grid-area: tags; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 3px 6px; min-height: 17px; } .ds-tag { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--fg-muted); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 2px; padding: 0 4px; } .ds-version { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--fg-muted); }

components.name: Printed Plate
components.description: A generated image framed as a physical print: paper margin, vignette, slight desaturation.
components.css: .ds-plate { position: relative; display: block; padding: 3px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--print-edge); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-plate img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; filter: saturate(0.9) contrast(1.05); } .ds-plate::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.38); pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Segmented Switch
components.description: A bordered strip for Config's sections; the chosen part takes the wash and an inset 2px rose underline.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--field); overflow: hidden; } .ds-seg button { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--hairline); background: none; color: var(--fg-muted); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--fg); background: var(--wash); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--wash); color: var(--fg); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent); }

components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(460px, 100%); display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-top: 2px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius-card); box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); } .ds-dialog-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; } .ds-dialog-mark { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--accent); } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); } .ds-dialog-body { margin: 0; color: var(--fg); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-dialog-foot { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-dialog-no, .ds-dialog-yes { height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-no { color: var(--fg-muted); } .ds-dialog-no:hover { color: var(--fg); background: var(--wash); } .ds-dialog-yes { color: var(--invalid); } .ds-dialog-yes:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--invalid) 9%, transparent); } .ds-dialog-no:focus-visible, .ds-dialog-yes:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Salad Studio is a dark room with the lights low and one rose safelight on. The operator stands at a bench, reads instruments, and hangs finished plates on a contact sheet. Nothing on screen is decorative for its own sake: every surface is either the bench (navy), the paper (cream), or the safelight (rose), and the interface's job is to make a long, asynchronous render legible without becoming the thing you look at.

The system is built from two materials. The first is a dark, cool navy that recedes: --bg for the page, --ground for the working pane, --well and --field for places you type or read a log. The second is printed paper: a warm cream for text, a mono face for anything that is data, and a narrow paper margin around every generated image so a plate reads as a physical print. Palatino appears in exactly four places — the wordmark, the page title, the empty-sheet title and the aside name — so the serif stays a sign rather than a voice.

Density is that of a workbench: 34px controls, 36px fields, 48px table rows, 12px rhythm inside a row and 22px between sections. Motion is almost absent; a 120ms border or background shift acknowledges a press, and the only looping motion is a render's spinner and a page's breathing tick. The confirmed anti-reference is the generic dark SaaS dashboard: no glass, no gradients, no glow, no purple, no rounded cards floating in space.
keyCharacteristics: Navy bench, cream paper, one rose safelight.
Mono for data and labels; Segoe UI for prose; Palatino for signs.
Flat by default; depth is tonal, with shadows only for what floats.
Nearly square corners: 1px plates, 2px chips, 3px controls, 4px cards.
Every state carries a word, not just a colour.
Generated images are printed: paper margin, vignette, slightly desaturated.

rules.name: The Safelight Rule
rules.body: Rose is light, not paint. One primary rose fill per page; selection uses Rose Wash; a rose panel, rose background section, or rose heading is out of system.

rules.name: The Token Or Nothing Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from the token block in ui/src/styles.css. A hex literal in a component fails tests/test_theme.py, which also holds every text pair the page draws to WCAG AA.

rules.name: The Word Beside The Colour Rule
rules.body: No state is carried by hue alone. Meters write Ready, Starting, Not started; log lines carry a level word; token checks write their state under the slot.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Palatino appears only in the wordmark, the page title, an empty-sheet title and the aside name. A serif paragraph, a serif button, or a serif table cell is out of system.

rules.name: The Mono Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Mono marks anything a person compares, copies or trusts: addresses, counts, sizes, ids, times, keys, JSON, logs. Prose in mono and data in a proportional face both break the rule.

rules.name: The Fixed Frame Rule
rules.body: The window is a bench, not a page: bars, rail, status and strip stay put and the page body is the only thing that scrolls. A full-window scroll or a floating toolbar is out of system.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest has no shadow. If it is not a dialog, a floating control, or a printed plate, it is separated by tone and a 1px rule.

rules.name: The Nearly Square Rule
rules.body: Four pixels is the ceiling. A pill button, an 8px card, or a circular avatar introduces a different product.

dos: Do put a mono label above every control, and write labels as short nouns: Width, Steps, Seed, Gateway URL.
Do print a plate: paper margin, 1px radius, vignette, slight desaturation, before it appears in a strip, a history row, or an aside.
Do give a disabled action its reason in words, in the button's title or the page's note.
Do use tabular figures and a fixed-width slot for any count that changes while the page is open.
Do keep one rose fill per page and let Rose Wash carry selection.
Do name the level in words next to the colour, in logs, meters and token dots.
Do keep page bodies scrolling under a fixed frame, and let long lines cap near 80ch.
donts: Don't add glass, backdrop blur outside the dialog scrim, gradients, glow, or purple; the confirmed anti-reference is the generic dark SaaS dashboard.
Don't round anything past 4px, and don't turn a control into a pill.
Don't use the rose as a large fill, a section background, or a heading colour.
Don't set a paragraph, button, or table cell in Palatino; the serif is a sign.
Don't put prose in mono or data in a proportional face.
Don't use pure white or pure black; paper cream and tray ink are the ends of the range.
Don't show a bare img for a generated plate, and don't show an empty grid where a dashed frame and a sentence belong.
Don't invent a second accent for a new state; reach for the telltales, and write the state's word.
